extracted.name: Smokey Spicy Chicken Salad
extracted.description: I like to created alternative items. Things like spicing up chicken salad and doing a new Twist on it.
ingredient_lines: 12.5 oz chicken (can is fine; press out all of the liquid from it)
2 sakes of shakes of wicked good salt
instruction_lines: Drain completely and press the chicken to remove all the liquid from the canned chicken and add to a bowl.
Add all the dry ingredients to the Bowl
Add the mustard mayonnaise and aioli to the bowl.
Mix it all together while breaking up the chicken into shredded pieces.
Let the mixture rest for at least 1/2 hour before serving.
